deployments_detail.use: AI-powered Clubcard Challenges (EagleAI): 4.5M+ personalised challenges/coupons monthly to 24M households; Adobe strategic AI partnership (agentic AI, Firefly)

Three-year strategic generative AI partnership with Mistral AI, including a joint AI lab, giving Tesco full access to Mistral's commercial models to build GenAI tools for internal workflows (colleague analytics/forecasting copilots, product content generation and compliance, document drafting) and customer experience, starting with a revamp of personalised Clubcard offers. [Mistral AI]

GetGo checkout-free convenience store using computer vision (ceiling cameras) and weight sensors to automatically track items and charge customers via the Tesco app on exit, with no scanning or checkout. [Trigo]
Operational-research/ML markdown and price-reduction optimisation engine, which won the OR Society President's Medal, continuously improving millions of price reductions.
Machine-learning demand forecasting to predict product demand and maintain on-shelf availability across stores.
AI optimisation of home-delivery routes and scheduling to open up additional delivery slots and cut driven distance.
AI/optimisation of online order picking and depot-to-store truck routing, enhancing millions of online order picks across thousands of stores and optimising thousands of truck routes.

Strategic AI partnership with Adobe to personalise customer experiences and Clubcard loyalty, delivering more timely and relevant offers, product recommendations and recipe ideas across store, online and app. [Adobe]
